messages:
maria-se: Quick sync — Verity Health POC kickoff. We need a compact timeline (milestones + hard blockers) and clear owners for infra, security signoff, data mapping, and front-end integration. POC starts wk of 2025-06-02. Can owners ack and share ETA for their deliverables?

ton y-eng: Infra ack. Need VPC peering + egress rules from their staging VPC. If networking approves today we can have a staging instance by Wed. Blocker: Verity needs to open 3 ports to our load balancer.

anya-ps: I'll own success criteria and acceptance tests. Proposed measurable goals: (1) 95th perc latency < 300ms on a 32-token prompt set, (2) embeddings similarity > 0.88 on validation set, (3) no PII logged in hosted logs. I can write the test harness by Tue.

kevin-soleng: Front-end/integration here. I need the contract for streaming + tool-calling. Also pinging for code review: PR https://github.com/redwood/verity-integ/pull/42 — please review by EOD tomorrow.

maria-se: Thanks — owners so far: infra: tony-eng, success/tests: anya-ps, front-end: kevin-soleng, runtime/canary + ops: dinesh-sre, security/compliance: ? (who can take?) :eyes:

dinesh-sre: I can own runtime rollout. Plan: canary 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 2 days. Need model variant tag to pin (cpu/quantized vs gpu FP16). Also request from eng: set autoscale min=1, burst to 4 for the trial window.

maria-se: @security-team any volunteer for signoff? We need KMS key proof and an audit window.

kevin-soleng: FYI: front-end will expect streaming SSE at /v1/chat/stream and a fallback to polled /v1/chat for older clients.

tony-eng: Networking note: sample firewall rule they need to add:
```
allow from 10.14.0.0/16 to LB_IP ports: 443, 8443
```
I put a ticket in netops #network-requests. ETA for peering: 48h once they confirm CIDR.

deploy-bot: staging-verity environment created (env-id: sv-2025-06-01-17). Logs will be available at https://console.redwood/infrastack/env/sv-2025-06-01-17

maria-se: Great progress. Action items: (1) security volunteer, (2) netops confirm CIDR, (3) kevin to attach contract to PR, (4) dinesh to specify model tag. Can we aim to have everything ready for first canary by 2025-06-04? :thumbsup:
